A correct solution written another way: an Office table (delimiter, column names, separators),
a hand-written amount reader with no regular expressions, BOM detection by table, an
accumulator object, the CSV written into a buffer and saved as bytes. Keeps every rule of
README.md.

The folder also runs the reference `_solve.py` (`python consolidate.py`), so orders.csv and
summary.json are left in the folder as the task asks.
